acceptanceCriteria.text: Final serialized bytes are measured after all result decoration/finalization.
Every successful response satisfies the effective hard byte/token invariant.
If mandatory fields alone cannot fit, the behavior is explicit and bounded rather than returning an oversized result.
Regression coverage includes oversized `identity.upstreams` and asserts the final serialized byte count.

issue.title: fix: enforce the MCP hard response budget after final serialization
